logline: A harbourmaster's daughter must find her missing father before the island decides he chose to leave.
themes: loyalty to family against loyalty to the truth
a small place keeping its secrets

characters.name: Mara Quinn
characters.need: to trust people outside her family
characters.voiceNotes: short, dry sentences; never says sorry
characters.appearance: 32, tall, salt-stiff dark hair, her father's old oilskin coat

characters.name: Tomas Reyes
characters.need: to admit what he saw on Sunday
characters.voiceNotes: jokes when cornered, answers questions with questions
characters.appearance: 50s, broad, grey beard, rope burns on both hands

settings.name: Calder Harbour
settings.description: a stone harbour on a small Hebridean island, twelve moorings, a slipway and a one-room harbour office

settings.name: The harbour office
settings.description: smells of paraffin and old paper; the logbook lives under the barometer

timeline: Sunday: the Gannet goes out at six
Sunday night: the Gannet does not come back
Tuesday: Mara arrives on the morning ferry
povPlan: Close third person, past tense, every chapter from Mara's point of view.
ending: Mara learns her father staged his disappearance to protect her from a debt, and chooses to tell the island the truth.
